name: PixelForge Studios
description: Crafting immersive gaming experiences, one pixel at a time.
story: PixelForge Studios, a rising star in the Polish indie gaming scene, seeks to boost brand awareness through motorsport. We believe in the synergy between the precision of racing and the detail-oriented world of game development. By sponsoring a team, we aim to connect with a wider audience of tech enthusiasts and showcase our commitment to pushing boundaries.
